article.abstract: Abstract Multi-sentence compression aims to generate a short and informative compression from several source sentences that deal with the same topic. In this work, we present a new corpus for the Multi-Sentence Compression (MSC) task in Portuguese and Spanish. We also provide on this corpus a comparison of two state-of-the-art MSC systems. Keywords: Annotated Corpus, Multi-Sentence Compression, Multilingual Corpus.
